result.rationale: The diff adds `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` in poll_feed.rb, calling `i.content` on every feed item unconditionally. The site setting is advertised as 'feed_polling_url: URL of RSS/ATOM feed', but simple-rss only exposes `content` for Atom feeds; RSS 2.0 items use `description`, so `i.content` would be nil and `.scrub` would raise NoMethodError. I cannot fully verify simple-rss's attribute mapping from the diff alone, so confidence is limited, but the unconditional accessor plus RSS support claim makes the mechanism plausible.
